activities.title: "The Sky's the Limit" Neon Tunnel
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1, Underground walkway between Concourses B and C

An absolute essential ORD experience. This 744-foot-long kinetic light installation by Michael Hayden features a mile of neon tubing that dances to a synthesized version of George Gershwin's 'Rhapsody in Blue'. It makes the walk between concourses feel like a retro-futuristic ride.
activities.image_attribution: Derivative of "Disco Tunnel" by Paul VanDerWerf (CC BY 2.0)

activities.title: Tortas Frontera by Rick Bayless
activities.description:
Locations:
• Terminal 1, near Gate B10
• Terminal 3, near Gate K4
• Terminal 5, near Gate M18

Ranked multiple times as the Top Ten Best Airport Restaurants in the United States. Tortas Frontera serves up incredible hand-crafted tortas (griddle-baked Mexican sandwiches), fresh guacamole, and margaritas using ingredients sourced from local Midwestern farms.
activities.hours:
• Terminal 1 Daily: 4:30 AM - 9:00 PM
• Terminal 3 Daily 5:00 AM - 9:30 PM
• Terminal 5 Daily 5:00 AM - 10:00 PM

activities.title: Berghoff Cafe
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1, near Gate C26

An airport offshoot of the legendary Chicago institution that opened its doors in 1898. Grab an iconic hand-carved corned beef or Reuben sandwich, a warm soft pretzel, and a cold German-style root beer or draft beer while waiting for your flight.

activities.title: Billy Goat Tavern and Grill
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1, near Gate C19

Cheezborger, cheezborger, cheezborger! This legendary, no-frills Chicago tavern gained national fame from a classic Saturday Night Live sketch featuring John Belushi. Stop by for a classic, stacked thin-patty cheeseburger on a Kaiser roll for a quintessential, quick taste of the city.

activities.title: Millennium Park & The Bean
activities.description:
Location: Downtown Chicago (The Loop).

If you have a layover of 6+ hours, jump on the CTA Blue Line and head straight downtown. Walk around Millennium Park, take a reflection selfie at Cloud Gate (The Bean), and grab a slice of deep-dish pizza. It's a direct train ride right out of the airport.
activities.transit_instruction: Follow signs for 'Trains to City' in the airport and take the CTA Blue Line to Washington/Dearborn. Budget heavy buffer time for TSA re-entry.

activities.title: Grumman F4F-3 Wildcat ("Butch O'Hare")
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 2, directly past the security checkpoint

A miraculously salvaged WWII Navy fighter plane matching the exact livery of "White F-15," flown by airport namesake and Medal of Honor recipient Edward "Butch" O'Hare.
activities.image_attribution: Derivative of "Grumman F4F-3 Wildcat - Butch O'Hare White F-15 Replica at ORD 1" by Koyah7d (CC BY-SA 3.0)

activities.title: Brachiosaurus Skeleton Cast ("Ernestine")
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1, Concourse B, near Gate B8

A massive, four-story (72 feet high) fiberglass cast of a Brachiosaurus on loan from the Field Museum. It creates a stunning juxtaposition against modern jets.

activities.title: Tortas Frontera by Rick Bayless
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1 (Gate B11), Terminal 3 (Gate K4), Terminal 5 (Gate M18)

Outstanding Mexican street food curated by celebrity chef Rick Bayless. Famous for griddle-baked tortas layered with high-quality proteins and fresh produce sourced directly from ORD's Aeroponic Garden.

activities.title: Publican Tavern
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 3, near Gate K1

A high-end spin-off of the Fulton Market institution. Offers a European beer hall aesthetic, local craft beers, and a phenomenal Double Burger made with heritage beef from Slagel Family Farm.

activities.title: ChiBoys
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 3, near Gate H5

Premium, independent Chicago streetwear that tells the city's story through innovative neighborhood-centric designs, avoiding standard sports team clichés.

activities.title: Vosges Haut-Chocolat
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1 (Gate B6) and Terminal 3 (Gate H4/K3)

Avant-garde flavor laboratory built like a luxury jewelry boutique. Sells provocative, gourmet truffles mixing premium chocolate with exotic spices like Naga chilies and Bulgarian rose water.

activities.title: Garrett Popcorn Shops
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1 (Gates B8, B14) and Terminal 3 (Gate H2)

A Chicago tradition since 1949. Pick up a tightly sealed tin of the iconic "Garrett Mix" (sweet CaramelCrisp and savory CheeseCorn) crafted in copper kettles.

activities.title: The Field Museum Store
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1, Concourse B, near Gate B8

Located adjacent to the Brachiosaurus skeleton, offering highly engaging, museum-quality educational toys, paleontology gifts, and complex science books.

activities.title: O'Hare Yoga Room
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 3, Mezzanine Level of the Rotunda Building

A private, shoe-free sanctuary designed for physical decompression. Features bamboo floors, frosted windows, exercise mats, and video-guided stretching techniques.

activities.title: Hilton Chicago O'Hare Health Club
activities.description:
Location: Hilton Chicago O'Hare Airport Hotel, Arcade Level (accessible via underground walkways)

A massive fitness ecosystem perfect for long layovers. Offers day passes granting access to an Olympic-sized indoor lap pool, steam rooms, saunas, running tracks, and full locker room shower services.
activities.hours: Mon-Fri: 5:00 AM - 10:00 PM, Sun: 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM

activities.title: Terminal Getaway Spa
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1 (Gate B12) and Terminal 3 (Gate H1)

A legitimate, high-end wellness clinic operating at the gate. Features private treatment rooms for rapid 10-minute chair massages or full 90-minute deep-tissue Swedish massages.

activities.title: O'Hare Aeroponic Garden
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 3, Rotunda Building (Mezzanine Level)

Escape the terminal noise in the world's first aeroponic garden inside an airport. This lush, green space grows fresh herbs and produce used by several of the airport's restaurants (like Tortas Frontera). It's a fantastic, quiet spot to relax, breathe some fresh air, and recharge.
